# pvecli ct info

Show detailed information about a container.

```text
pvecli ct info [CTID] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `CTID` | Container ID (CTID). |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
